clips.title: The story
paras: Aggem Thorncurse is a spectral quilboar encountered deep within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. Bound beyond death to the service of his tribe, he fights alongside Warlord Ramtusk and Death Speaker Jargba to defend their sacred redoubt against intruders.

Within the heart of Razorfen Kraul, the quilboar fight desperately to protect their ancestral dens from outsiders. Aggem Thorncurse is not among the living defenders; instead, he lingers as a restless spirit. Bound to the physical realm by dark geomancy and shamanic rites, Aggem takes up arms when intruders threaten the tribe's warlord.
